sources.publisher: NOAA, National Geodetic Survey, Remote Sensing Division
sources.title: Coastal Mapping Program Project Completion Report: Project LA2212-CS-T, Port of Lake Charles/Cameron, Louisiana
sources.inspection_scope: Complete target outline compared with the page 3 labeled overview, including the upstream narrowing, broad lower lake, western lobe, ship channel and Cameron connection.
sources.publication_date_note: The report describes May 2022 compilation and final review, but no explicit publication date was verified.
sources.source_limit: The labeled project overview is generalized context; its blue project boundary is not a waterbody boundary or a formal name instrument.

sources.title: State of Louisiana Coastal and Estuarine Land Conservation Program Plan
sources.inspection_scope: Printed page 10 (PDF page 12) supplies Calcasieu Lake naming and lower-river estuarine/tidal context. Figure 14 supplies regional planning context only and is not a second detailed identity map.
sources.source_limit: State planning text and regional map do not assign exact extents to each named lake or measure present salinity.

independence_note: NOAA’s project report and Louisiana’s state plan are distinct publications; only the NOAA overview supplies the detailed cartographic correspondence used here.
included_evidence_limit: The included files retain factual observations and bibliographic references. The original publications and inspection materials are not included. Offline validation checks included records and selected public-domain lake geometry; it does not reopen those publications or reproduce visual map judgments.
